name: Department of Trade, Industry and Competition (the dtic)
notes: UPDATED 2026-10-20: the earlier domain ditoc.gov.za was a typo; the canonical site is thedtic.gov.za. Internship posts also appear in DPSA circulars.

name: South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA)
notes: Reference source for NQF qualification levels, not an opportunity source. Its Careers section only describes an e-recruitment system and lists no vacancies (checked 2026-10-17), so left inactive.

name: South African Government — Government Jobs This Week
notes: Official national government discovery index linking to the current Public Service Vacancy Circular and related government vacancy notices. Treat linked circular/PDF as primary evidence; extract circular number and publication date. Research checked 2026-10-18; no RSS/API endpoint confirmed.

name: National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) — How to Apply
notes: Official NSFAS application guidance and funding-cycle announcements. Pair with myNSFAS only as the application destination; verify intake year, opening/closing dates and eligibility on the official NSFAS page. Research checked 2026-10-18; 2027 cycle was reported open 2026-09-18 through 2026-10-31, so recheck dates before publication.

name: Department of Water and Sanitation - e-Recruitment
notes: Verified 2026-10-20. Official e-recruitment job list (reference number, category, closing date, More Info link per post). About 45 posts on the check date.

name: Department of Water and Sanitation - Internship Programme
notes: Verified 2026-10-20. Non-technical internship programme for graduates and learner interns. No fixed intake dates; the page says adverts appear on the website and in print media.

name: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR)
notes: Verified 2026-10-20. Opportunities centre linking to Learning-Opportunities, Current-Vacancies and Archived-Vacancies. Current-Vacancies said "No current vacancies" on the check date. Do not use the stale dmre.gov.za mirror.

name: Department of Social Development (national)
notes: Verified 2026-10-20. National vacancies page; it said "Currently no details on Vacancies" on the check date, so expect empty results until posts appear. The KwaZulu-Natal department is a separate source.

name: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies (DCDT)
notes: Verified 2026-10-20. Vacancy and board-nomination circulars; no internships seen on the check date. Posts are undated, so use the linked circular PDFs for dates.

name: Department of Agriculture (formerly DALRRD)
notes: NOT VERIFIED 2026-10-20: the page blocks automated fetching, so left inactive. It appears in official-domain search results. The department has been renamed; confirm the canonical domain before activating.

name: Department of Home Affairs - e-Recruitment
notes: Right organisation but the page is rendered with JavaScript (only "Initializing..." was visible on 2026-10-20), so a plain HTML crawl will see nothing. HR circular PDFs are also posted under dha.gov.za/images/PDFs/jobs/. Left inactive until a crawl method is chosen.

name: National Youth Development Agency (NYDA) - Opportunities
notes: Verified 2026-10-22. Curated index of vacancies, internships, learnerships, bursaries and grants. Most items are links to other organisations, many via tinyurl.com short links and without dates. Treat as a discovery lead only: confirm each role on the employer's own page before publishing.

name: Funza Lushaka Bursary Programme (Department of Basic Education)
notes: Verified 2026-10-22. Teacher-training bursary. The page stated returning students apply by 30 Nov 2026 and new applicants by 31 Jan 2027, via the eservices.gov.za portal. Time-sensitive: re-check dates before publishing.

name: SAICA Thuthuka Bursary Fund
notes: Verified 2026-10-22. Chartered-accountancy bursary run by the professional body SAICA. No explicit application window on the page; applicants must also write the NBT before the end of August. Re-check eligibility and dates before publishing.

name: National Research Foundation (NRF) - Postgraduate Bursaries and Scholarships
notes: Verified 2026-10-22. Lists DSTI-NRF postgraduate calls (honours, masters, doctoral). The page showed 2025 and 2026 cycles; a 2027 call page exists at nrf.ac.za/dsti-nrf-postgraduate-student-funding-for-the-2027-academic-year/ (found in search, not fetched).

name: Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) - External Bursary Scheme
notes: Verified 2026-10-22. Undergraduate bursaries (finance, STEM, law). 2027 applications opened 1 Jun 2026 and closed 30 Sep 2026, so any listing must be marked expired. Expect the next window around June.

name: Development Bank of Southern Africa (DBSA) - Careers
notes: Verified 2026-10-22. Careers page with the Young Talent graduate programme (dbsa.org/start-dbsa-graduate-programme). Open vacancies are on an external portal, https://dbsa.erecruit.co/candidateapp/Jobs/Browse.aspx (link seen, not fetched).

name: Mandela Rhodes Foundation - Scholarship
notes: Verified 2026-10-22. Postgraduate leadership scholarship. Class of 2028 applications open 9 Mar 2027 (March to November each year); 2027 intake closed.

name: Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) - Careers
notes: Right organisation but this is a landing page with no readable post list (checked 2026-10-22); vacancies are on careers.idc.co.za. Left inactive until the portal is verified.

name: Youth Employment Service (YES)
notes: Right organisation but the site lists no opportunities (checked 2026-10-22); youth are sent to portal.yes4youth.co.za and SAYouth. Left inactive as a reference.

name: SAYouth.mobi (Harambee)
notes: Free national platform for jobs, learnerships and internships, run by the non-profit Harambee. It has Join/Log in links and it is unclear whether listings are public. Review its terms before any crawling; left inactive.
